22:1.sourceText: Ἤγγιζεν δὲ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων ἡ λεγομένη Πάσχα.
22:1.targetText: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

22:2.sourceText: καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὸ πῶς ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν· ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν.
22:2.targetText: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people.

groups.note: τὸ πῶς ("how") is rendered a way.
BSB names Jesus for the pronoun αὐτόν ("him").

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

22:3.sourceText: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Σατανᾶς εἰς Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Ἰσκαριώτην, ὄντα ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τῶν δώδεκα·
22:3.targetText: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.

groups.note: εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ("entered into") is rendered entered.
ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ ("of the number") is rendered one of.

unmappedSource.reason: BSB gives the name as Judas Iscariot without rendering τὸν καλούμενον ("the one called").
The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

22:4.sourceText: καὶ ἀπελθὼν συνελάλησεν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ στρατηγοῖς τὸ πῶς αὐτοῖς παραδῷ αὐτόν.
22:4.targetText: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.

groups.note: The finite verb συνελάλησεν ("discussed with") is rendered as an infinitive after went.
BSB names Jesus for the pronoun αὐτόν ("him").

unmappedTarget.reason: English names the subject; the Greek gives it only in the participle ἀπελθών.

22:5.sourceText: καὶ ἐχάρησαν, καὶ συνέθεντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι.
22:5.targetText: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

22:6.sourceText: καὶ ἐξωμολόγησεν, καὶ ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν ἄτερ ὄχλου αὐτοῖς.
22:6.targetText: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.

groups.note: The imperfect ἐζήτει ("he kept seeking") is rendered began to look for.
BSB names Jesus for the pronoun αὐτόν ("him").

unmappedSource.reason: BSB leaves the opening connective καί untranslated.

unmappedTarget.reason: English names the subject; the Greek gives it only in the verb ending of ἐξωμολόγησεν.

22:7.sourceText: Ἦλθεν δὲ ἡ ἡμέρα τῶν ἀζύμων, ᾗ ἔδει θύεσθαι τὸ πάσχα·
22:7.targetText: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.

groups.note: The dative ᾗ marks the time (on which); BSB follows a reading with an extra word here.
τὸ πάσχα here is the Passover lamb that was sacrificed.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

22:8.sourceText: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάνην εἰπών Πορευθέντες ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν τὸ πάσχα, ἵνα φάγωμεν.

groups.note: Same name, spelled differently in BSB's Greek text.

unmappedSource.reason: BSB leaves the opening connective καί untranslated.

unmappedTarget.reason: English names the subject; the Greek gives it only in the verb ending of ἀπέστειλεν.

unmappedSource.reason: The connective δέ is not separately expressed in this English wording.
BSB leaves the addressee αὐτῷ ("to him") unexpressed.

22:12.sourceText: κἀκεῖνος ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον· ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε.
22:12.targetText: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”

22:13.sourceText: ἀπελθόντες δὲ εὗρον καθὼς εἰρήκει αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

English supplies an object for found; the Greek has none.

22:14.sourceText: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡ ὥρα, ἀνέπεσεν, καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι σὺν αὐτῷ.

22:15.targetText: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.

groups.note: Ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἐπεθύμησα ("with desire I desired") is an emphatic Hebraism, rendered eagerly desired.
The infinitive παθεῖν with subject με ("me to suffer") is rendered My suffering.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

22:16.sourceText: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ φάγω αὐτὸ ἕως ὅτου πληρωθῇ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ.
22:16.targetText: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”

groups.note: οὐκέτι οὐ μή ("no longer, by no means") is rendered not ... again.
The aorist subjunctive under οὐ μή is rendered as an English future.

22:17.sourceText: καὶ δεξάμενος ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας εἶπεν Λάβετε τοῦτο καὶ διαμερίσατε εἰς ἑαυτούς·

unmappedTarget.reason: English coordinator; the participle εὐχαριστήσας is rendered as the finite verb gave thanks.

22:18.sourceText: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως οὗ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔλθῃ.

The aorist subjunctive under οὐ μή is rendered as an English future.
